---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new MCP tool, TR coverage, indicator, or SDK capability
title: ''
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. *"When I ask the LLM about [...], it has to call X and Y separately and the response is too large to fit in context."*

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What would you like the MCP server (or the SDK) to do? If you're proposing a new semantic tool, sketch the input and output shape.

**Scope (check what applies)**
- [ ] New MCP tool (semantic wrapper around an existing TR)
- [ ] New TR coverage in the catalog (callable via `ls_call_tr`)
- [ ] New indicator
- [ ] Account / order / realtime — note this is targeted for v0.2.x or later, not the v0.1.x read-only market-data line
- [ ] SDK-side capability (`RedoxNet.LsOpenApi.Core` only)
- [ ] Other:

**Relevant LS TR / docs link**
If your request maps to a specific LS OpenAPI TR, paste the link:
- TR code / name:
- LS docs URL:

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any workarounds you currently use, including `ls_call_tr` invocations.

**Additional context**
Anything else that would help us scope or prioritize.
